title: SpecEvo：利用大语言模型进行推测性进化，实现低成本科学发现
summary: SpecEvo是一个多LLM协作框架，用轻量模型并行生成候选程序并汇总成功、失败与饱和方向的经验，仅在搜索停滞时由前沿模型介入。在176个任务上匹配或超越前沿基线，API成本降低最多80%，方程发现效率提升1.5倍。
summary_en: SpecEvo is a multi-LLM framework where lightweight models run parallel speculators and an advisor that consolidates successes, failures, and saturated directions, while a frontier-model navigator intervenes only at sparse checkpoints when search stagnates. Across 176 tasks it matches or beats frontier baselines with up to 80% lower API cost and 1.5x better evaluation efficiency on equation discovery.
